title: 2026/08/20 - TI
machineSummary: A regulator says a water entity must improve asset management, noting a projected $18 billion capital spend against a $9 billion asset value. The regulator also said they monitor retail fuel margins fortnightly to address "rocket and feather" pricing, suggesting active scrutiny helps moderate company behaviour.
